## Overview

Gem version constant.
## Interface

- `version.rb:OmnibusSoftware::VERSION` reads the repository VERSION file.
## Invariants

- `version.rb:VERSION` strips whitespace and freezes the string.
## Side Effects

- `version.rb:VERSION` reads disk at require time.
## Verification

From the `omnibus-software` repository root after installing the Gemfile dependencies: `bundle exec rake test` loads all software definitions; `bundle exec rake style` checks Ruby style. Full platform builds are separate and execute the build side effects above.
